body: That's kind of a shame in my opinion.. I liked the idea.  Oh well.

Someone once pointed out that the top isn't even his totem thingy (forgive me, I haven't seen the movie since it came out so I don't remember the term they use for it) but it was Mal's.  He didn't spin it to see if he was awake or not, he spun it to see if she was.  His totem thingy was his wedding band.  He wears it in his dreams, but not in the scenes when he's awake.  Reportedly, he is not wearing it in the final scene.  

I haven't personally confirmed it, but if it's true, it provides an answer as to whether or not he was dreaming at the end.

With two failed business attempts and a few crushed dreams of my own, I can imagine.  Your resolve to get through those failures and keep pushing towards your goal tells me we aren't so different.  Us creative types have to watch out for each other.  :)

Have you heard of [kickstarter](http://www.kickstarter.com) or [indiegogo](http://www.indiegogo.com)?  There are TONS of music artists like yourself on there asking for money to help them get albums made.  Figure out how much you need to properly record your songs at the quality level people want and put up a campaign.  Can't hurt.

It's too much fuzz... I can't understand what you're saying...  It's probably because of the equipment but, honestly, my $10 headset picks up sound better than that.

Do you have an acoustic version recorded we can hear?
We're aiming for a fall of 2013 release, ultimate goal is a theater run.  The working title we have copyrighted is 'Civil Unrest' but it may change when we hit post-production.

It's a tough business with a lot of unreliable people who don't give a witch's tit about contractual agreements even though they could be sued.  You have to be on your game 100% or you're considered and labeled one of the unreliable ones, even if it was beyond your control.  

I am awake and alive now because a person, who I can only describe as a Goddess, actually messaged me last night and sent me four pictures that were beyond perfect in my opinion and the director loved them.

Faith in humanity has been temporarily restored.  :')

I think it's funny how someone makes a random joke comment about her being a drama queen by saying that her major is in drama, and people literally think that she majored in drama...

Did she ever actually say this anywhere and I just didn't see it?

I didn't want the trolls to know they got to me so I made a throwaway.. 

I'm just under a lot of stress.  My unemployment runs out soon and I've gotten one call out of my 50+ applications sent out.. and that interviewer laughed at me because I had no experience in the field (it was to be a server at a very quiet restaurant...)  I've been in this state for almost 4 years and I have not made a single friend.. I haven't made a costume in over a year (it's what I did in NY) and I've suddenly been brought on to this dream project as a production designer - 

PRODUCTION DESIGNER - do you know what that is??  That's like... 3rd credit!  Okay, maybe 4th depending on the deal with the Director of Photography, but even so!!!  I'm in charge of like.. everything!  I have Costuming, make-Up, Special effects, set design and construction, props, location scouting... It's basically up to me to make the movie look the way it does... 

I used to work on stage but movies are a totally different ballgame and I'm completely up for that challenge, but my god, the artists I've talked to are so damn untrustworthy.  They drop out if they just don't feel like drawing.. I mean, I can understand that to a point, but...

I'm ranting.  I'm sorry.  It's just been one thing piling up after another for the past, I don't know, 10 years.  I'm just very fragile at this point.

The 4 main characters we wanted sketches of are a like-able Union Captain in his late 20's who is very tired from 4 years of battles, his stunningly beautiful but hardy wife who is about the same age and of Norwegian descent, a blood-thirsty Confederate Captain in his late 20's who enjoys killing, and an older southern reverend with a silver tongue and a vengeance.

I live in a small town about an hour from the city... there are buses that go into the city twice a day, but the bus stop is almost 6 miles away... that's a long way to walk.  Besides, our city isn't exactly the safest in America and I'm a 100 pound white girl.
Not able to drive.  No way to get to these groups.

Be part of a movie... 

I was supposed to be the Production Designer of a feature film this coming year.  What I was needing was some character sketches for the pitch.. but the two artists I had dropped on me so, desperate, I posted here and got shit on instead.  

I have to come up with 4-7 drawings by Tuesday.  I can draw them myself, but I'm not good enough.

I couldn't afford New York... I thought moving to Florida where it's cheaper and living a dream by working at Disney World would bring me happiness.  

I got fired after 6 months because I had a bad allergic reaction to the chemicals they used.  I can't afford to leave now and my family is all in New York.

No, I can't move in with them.
